Name: Bathhouse Milk Vending Machine
Author: Ekibo3
Description:
[center][size=3][color=#d0e0e3]After relaxing in the bathhouse, it felt like something was missing, so I added a simple vending machine you can interact with, inspired by the tradition of drinking milk after an onsen [/color]🥛[/size]

[/center]
By default, the machine sells:
• Milk
• Goat Milk

﻿It also includes a few original Joja drinks:
• Joja Coffee Milk
• Joja Banana Milk
• Joja Strawberry Milk
These come with their own sprites and can be enabled or disabled in the config.

For a more authentic feel with glass milk bottles, you may wish to pair this with one of the many lovely bottle retexture mods available on Nexus.

[color=#cfe2f3][size=5]Requirements[/size][/color]
• SMAPI
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[color=#cfe2f3][size=5]Installation[/size][/color]
Download and extract this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder

[color=#cfe2f3][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/color]
This mod is designed to automatically include items if they are installed:
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25335]Milkable Sheep by radmaninoff[/url]
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38891]Strawberry milk cows by AbrahMods[/url]
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23551]Brown Cows Give Chocolate Milk by queermoth[/url]
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods by Wildflourmods[/url]
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26412]Packaged Milk for Chocolate Valley by That1Hermit
[/url]﻿• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44308]Larky's Strawberry Cows by larkylovesyou2[/url]
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24281]Ice Cream Cows by UncleArya
[/url]
Working on support for:
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22565]Bathhouse Hot Spring by Sandman53 [/url]

Should be compatible with most mods. Tested with SVE, RSV and other major expansions.
